decisions.reason: The format reader/writer plug-ins sit at the core of the firm's data integration expertise and standards work, so in-house R&D can keep refining them from user feedback.
Authentication delegation builds on the firm's established security components and is cheap to maintain, though there is some risk it gets merged into the broader identity service.
The open GIS development framework is central to the firm's strategy of open, extensible components, and its developers and research ties give it strong capacity to evolve the framework.
The identity service for GIS applications was actively promoted and draws directly on existing platform integration knowledge, which makes continued development likely.
The business process consulting workshop uses the firm's decades of consulting and training know-how, has its own page, and needs few resources, so the firm can easily learn from early results.
